use-equations-to-represent AO has zero record_links because the textbook teaches a single word-to-equation skill (ch11-b005 onwards) that satisfies both translate and use-to-represent AOs; all word-to-equation records were placed on the translate AO.
translate-word-sentences AO has direct exercises (ch11-b008-i01..i10) but no reused exercise_item assessment was selected.

The curriculum splits a single skill into two AOs (po01 'Translate word sentences into mathematical equations' and po02 'Use mathematical equations to represent word sentences'). The textbook in ch11-b005 onwards teaches one activity that satisfies both, so the AO2 distinction is not reflected in the corpus.

The use-equations-to-represent AO is only supported by shared_foundation records (ch11-b001..b005 introducing equations and the translation activity) — that grounding is prerequisite, not direct AO-specific evidence.
